summary: Purpose: repair orchestration without weakening authority or auto-publishing Knowledge; TWR-W0: typed source selection, canonical independently verifiable identity, fail closed on omission/ambiguity/authority drift; TWR-W1: adapter owns deterministic paging, offsets, retries, and rejects stale/conflicting continuations; TWR-W2: adapter proves hash/range coverage, with typed failure or controlled refresh for gaps/conflicts/source changes; TWR-W3: execution/publication/review gates remain independent; unchanged semantics may use verified degraded successor, while invalid LKG, selection/authority drift, missing sources, and publication-integrity failures block; acceptance neither publishes Knowledge nor starts Bootstrap; TWR-W4: validator/coordinator creates immutable versioned receipts bound to candidate, contract, registry, authority envelope, Skill-input receipt, Knowledge freeze, and validator; current pointer advances only after full validation; TWR-W5: attempts use .skill-input-work/<plan-id>/<attempt-id>/ with lifecycle, leases, heartbeat, deterministic dry-run GC, approval-gated apply, protected references, and non-authorizing cleanup receipt; TWR-W6: non-authorizing end-to-end test covers W0-W5, resolves one current pointer, protects retention, and prevents invalid pointer advancement; ownership: VDD=draft/plan-ready, Maintainer=implementation authorization, Quick Dev=implementation-complete, Acceptance=acceptance-passed; no new lifecycle authority.
